## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6aac10592ddf3d7aa6c9128998cbc7cf5a996b07`

### ① Derived judgments

- **(a) It is a MOVE — RIGHT.** The checker's removed hunk (old `:899` onward, 413 lines) against `clause2-line.mjs:44-455` (412 lines) differs on exactly two lines: `export` added to `quoteLine` (module `:366`) and one trailing blank line dropped. Nothing reordered, nothing added, nothing else dropped; all 14 top-level names moved as one block in original order. The seat's measurement is confirmed.
- **(b) Exactly one reader — RIGHT.** `readClause2Line` is defined only at `clause2-line.mjs:408`, `CLAUSE2_VALUES` at `:53`, `CLAUSE2_ARMS` at `:91`; no second definition anywhere under `scripts`. The only other declaration-shaped regex in the tree is `check-clause2-carriers.mjs:927`, which reads the `Clause-②-correction` key — a different line, not a second reading. The checker imports the four symbols back at `:757`. No surviving CODE reference to a moved private helper: every remaining hit is docblock prose (`hasInlineClause2Key` `:916`; `readValueToken` `:938`, `:3125`, `:8185`, `:8188`; `clause2LineDescribes` `:8195`; `CLAUSE2_KEY_LINE` `:421`, `:916`, `:918`, `:970`, `:3045`, `:8422`; plus `check-changeset-no-major.mjs:1400`).
- **(c) Importers re-pointed consistently — RIGHT, one stale prose site.** `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:374`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs:394`, `post-stamped.mjs:820`, checker `:757`; four static importers, zero dynamic. Measured closures at this head: the ADR-0087 gate falls from 14 first-party modules to 5, no-major from 13 to 4, and `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` is in both — so the ADR-0087 staged-closure assertion (`:7040`) and objectui's `gateDeps` assertion (`:2349`, actual closure 5, requirement "at least 2") both agree with the real import graph. Every remaining path reference to the checker is still true (`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:627`, `:638`, `:728`, `:739` — the checker still imports `check-half-states.mjs`; `check-governed-merges.mjs:331`/`:1028`/`:1585`; `post-stamped.mjs:1760`; `dispatch-gates.mjs:6799`) — **except** `first-party-closure.mjs:21`, the third site of the same #16421 sentence the dev rewrote at ADR `:7027` and objectui `:2324`. It is past-tense narration and its "nine modules deep" was already stale on the base (measured 11 at base, 12 at head), so this PR did not make it false — NOTE, not a defect of this round; fold it in when step ② edits the same narration.
- **(d) The module imports nothing — RIGHT and load-bearing.** No `import`, no `require` in 455 lines. It matters because `check-changeset-no-major.mjs:391-392` still states it runs before `pnpm install`, and both gates stage their own first-party closure into a throwaway repo (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:7040`, `objectui-changeset-digest.mjs:2345-2349`) — that fixture now stages 5 files instead of 14.
- **(e) H3 workflow proof — the dev's reading is RIGHT, the CI half is thinner than the table suggests.** PR-event executors: `lint.yml` `Lint & Repo Gates` (`:1268` `check:pm-clause2-carriers`, `:1365` `check:pm-post-stamped`, `:3425` `check:objectui-changeset`, `:3489` `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, which is both gates' self-test per `package.json:149`) and `pr-automation.yml` `Check Changeset` (`:243`, gates at `:932-940` and `:1075`). Not reachable from a PR: `cut-rc.yml:77-79` is `workflow_dispatch` only; `release.yml:163-189` is push/schedule/dispatch and no `run:` step invokes either gate (prose at `:358`, `:590`; its gate block `:614-622` lists seven other checks; the only indirection is `setup-pnpm` and `docker-publish.yml`). **On this head `Check Changeset` is SKIPPED** by its own guard at `:289-291` because the PR carries `skip-changeset`, so the `--base MERGE_BASE` legs of both gates got no CI execution here; the only CI job that loads the extracted module is `Lint & Repo Gates`, which is still `in_progress` at review time. Honest reading, but the seat must see it `success` before enqueue.
- **(f) The 43-line header — one FAIL item and one note.** FAIL: `clause2-line.mjs:20-21` asserts the two gates "run in `lint.yml`, `pr-automation.yml`, `cut-rc.yml` and `release.yml`". False at this head for `release.yml`, and contradicted by the PR body's own workflow table in the same round. NOTE: `:10-14` says the ruling "retired" the label, `--pair`, the double-carrier discipline and the independence pair. True of the ruling, so not a falsehood about the code — but steps ② and ③ have not landed, and those mechanisms still RUN in this tree (`--pair` still judges C4/C6/C7; `check-governed-merges.mjs:331`/`:1028`/`:1585` still prescribe `--pair N` at 0; the label still exists), so a reader of the tree today is misled. One sentence fixes it: state that this file is step ① and that the label, `--pair` and the double-carrier discipline still run until steps ② and ③ land.
- **(g) Size — moving the docblocks is RIGHT, no trim owed.** 455 lines, roughly 45 of executable text. The rest is the #16421 arm rationale, the #17098 structural tells, the #13914 trailing-reasoning calibration and the four-axis alternation note, each sitting on the definition it justifies; trimming them would delete the only authority for where each boundary sits and would change no closure. The ruling's "small module" concern is the dependency closure, and that is what was delivered (14 to 5, 13 to 4, module closure 0). The "~40 lines" estimate was of the code and is accurate.
- **(h) Batteries are non-vacuous — RIGHT, judged from the code paths.** `check-changeset-no-major.mjs:4259-4300` drives the imported `readClause2Line` on four real shapes plus a `null` negative control; ablation ① (`CLAUSE2_VALUES` narrowed to one value) breaks the bare-line control assertion at `:4297`, which is exactly the first failure the report quotes — red is earned, not asserted. `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:639-640` reads the arm through the same imported reader, so ablation ② (`CLAUSE2_ARMS` narrowed) kills the `clause-②-narrowing` signal — red is earned. The checker's self-test pins the imported symbols at `:6708`, `:6723`, `:6726`, `:8508` (1140 cases read from the report; ⛔ not re-run here). `readValueToken` (`:224`) is defined and never called — `matchValueToken` (`:212`) is the one invoked at `:426` — dead code moved with its sibling, correctly noted and correctly not filed. One measurement slip in the PR body, not in the code: `quoteLine` has FIVE call sites left in the checker (`:3257`, `:3824`, `:6150`, `:6152`, `:6165`), not "four".

### ② Semver level

None, and `skip-changeset` is the right carrier. `scripts/**` is inside no package's `files[]`; the probe over `packages/` for the reader returns 0 with a 405-file positive control on the same instrument, so the instrument finds what is there. The diff touches no `package.json` and no lockfile. One consequence worth recording: that same label is what skipped `Check Changeset` on this head, so the semver call in ② and the missing CI leg in ①(e) are one fact, not two.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **`scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs` beyond the claim's surface — ACCEPT.** Required, not elective: at this head the ADR-0087 gate's closure no longer contains the checker, so `:2349`'s old membership test would be false and `check:objectui-changeset` (`lint.yml:3425`) would go red. Re-pointing one twin site and not the other is the #16421 defect itself.
2. **Merge of `origin/main` into the branch — ACCEPT.** `git diff --name-only 97aec39 6aac105` touches none of the PR's six files; it carries `.changeset`, `content/docs`, and `packages/{spec,rest,services,core}` only.
3. **§9 full refresh not run — ACCEPT.** No `package.json` and no `pnpm-lock.yaml` in the diff, no gate in the union reads a built `dist/`. Declared as a narrowing rather than left silent.
4. **`pnpm lint` narrowed to the six files — ACCEPT.** Both structural readings verified at this head: `eslint.config.mjs:971` declares the population that contains `.mjs`, and `:327-329` states this repo enables no type-aware linting for ANY file, so no untouched file's verdict can move.
5. **`--pair 19660` exit 4 on C6 — not a flag.** Expected resting state until this record exists; it clears on the record, not on the diff.
6. **The dispatch's `pnpm check:pm-governed-queue-guard` — confirmed absent from `package.json`.** The seat's error, not the dev's; running the script's own `--self-test` is the correct substitute and no verification was lost.
7. **CI in progress at report time — honest and within the standing clause.** At review time it is still the binding constraint: `Lint & Repo Gates` is the only job that loads the module on this head and it has not concluded, so this head is not enqueueable on the check axis regardless of this verdict. All other checks are `success` or `skipped`.

**What must change for PASS:** one sentence in `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs:20-21` — strike `release.yml` from the list of workflows the two gates run in, and say instead that `release.yml` names them in prose only (`:358`, `:590`) and never loads this module. Fold the ①(f) note into the same edit: one sentence saying this file is step ① and that the label, `--pair` and the double-carrier discipline still run in this tree until steps ② and ③ land. Nothing else in the diff needs to move.

**VERDICT: FAIL**
